title: fix(ai): count Gemini tool use prompt tokens as input tokens

@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@

@@ -517,19 +517,42 @@ def extract_gemini_web_search_count(response: Any) -> int:
     return 0
 
 
-def _extract_usage_from_metadata(metadata: Any) -> TokenUsage:
+def has_gemini_url_context(response: Any) -> bool:
+    """Whether a response or chunk carries URL context retrieval metadata."""
+    candidates = getattr(response, "candidates", None)
+    if not isinstance(candidates, (list, tuple)):
+        return False
+    return any(getattr(c, "url_context_metadata", None) for c in candidates)
+
+
+def _extract_usage_from_metadata(
+    metadata: Any, bill_tool_use_tokens: bool = False
+) -> TokenUsage:
     """
     Common logic to extract usage from Gemini metadata.
     Used by both streaming and non-streaming paths.
 
     Args:
         metadata: usage_metadata from Gemini response or chunk
+        bill_tool_use_tokens: whether tool_use_prompt_token_count is billed as
+            input (URL context). Google Search retrieval is not billed as input.
 
     Returns:
         TokenUsage with standardized usage
     """
+    input_tokens = getattr(metadata, "prompt_token_count", 0)
+
+    # Built-in tools report the retrieved content separately from
+    # prompt_token_count. URL context content is billed as input; Google Search
+    # retrieval is not, so only add it when the response used URL context.
+    # (A response that used both tools cannot be split from these counts.)
+    if bill_tool_use_tokens:
+        tool_use_tokens = getattr(metadata, "tool_use_prompt_token_count", 0)
+        if isinstance(tool_use_tokens, int) and tool_use_tokens > 0:
+            input_tokens += tool_use_tokens
+
     usage = TokenUsage(
-        input_tokens=getattr(metadata, "prompt_token_count", 0),
+        input_tokens=input_tokens,
         output_tokens=getattr(metadata, "candidates_token_count", 0),
     )

@@ -1741,3 +1741,40 @@ def test_ai_lane_client_routes_through_capture_ai(
     mock_client.capture.assert_not_called()
     assert mock_client.capture_ai.call_count == 1
     assert mock_client.capture_ai.call_args[1]["event"] == "$ai_generation"
+
+
+def _url_context_stream_chunks():
+    from google.genai import types
+
+    # URL context metadata arrives on an early chunk; usage on the last one.
+    first = types.GenerateContentResponse(
+        candidates=[types.Candidate(url_context_metadata=types.UrlContextMetadata())]
+    )
+    last = types.GenerateContentResponse(
+        usage_metadata=types.GenerateContentResponseUsageMetadata(
+            prompt_token_count=20,
+            tool_use_prompt_token_count=300,
+            candidates_token_count=10,
+            total_token_count=330,
+        )
+    )
+    return first, last
+
+
+def test_streaming_url_context_on_earlier_chunk_bills_tool_use_tokens(
+    mock_client, mock_google_genai_client
+):
+    first, last = _url_context_stream_chunks()
+    mock_google_genai_client.models.generate_content_stream.return_value = iter(
+        [first, last]
+    )
+
+    client = Client(api_key="test-key", posthog_client=mock_client)
+    response = client.models.generate_content_stream(
+        model="gemini-2.0-flash", contents=["Summarise this page"]
+    )
+    list(response)
+
+    props = mock_client.capture.call_args[1]["properties"]
+    assert props["$ai_input_tokens"] == 320
+    assert props["$ai_output_tokens"] == 10

+    assert props["$ai_input_tokens"] == 320

             {"type": "thinking", "thinking": "Hmm, "},
             {"type": "text", "text": "done"},
         ]
+
+
+class TestGeminiUsage:
+    @staticmethod
+    def _response(**candidate_kwargs):
+        return types.GenerateContentResponse(
+            candidates=[types.Candidate(**candidate_kwargs)],
+            usage_metadata=types.GenerateContentResponseUsageMetadata(
+                prompt_token_count=20,
+                tool_use_prompt_token_count=300,
+                candidates_token_count=10,
+                total_token_count=330,
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def test_url_context_tool_use_tokens_count_as_input(self):
+        # URL context content is billed as input.
+        resp = self._response(url_context_metadata=types.UrlContextMetadata())
+        for extract in (
+            extract_gemini_usage_from_response,
+            extract_gemini_usage_from_chunk,
+        ):
+            usage = extract(resp)
+            assert usage["input_tokens"] == 320
+            assert usage["output_tokens"] == 10
+
+    def test_search_retrieval_tokens_are_not_billed_as_input(self):
+        # Google Search retrieval is reported in tool_use_prompt_token_count but
+        # is not charged as input.
+        resp = self._response(
+            grounding_metadata=types.GroundingMetadata(web_search_queries=["q"])
+        )
+        for extract in (
+            extract_gemini_usage_from_response,
+            extract_gemini_usage_from_chunk,
+        ):
+            assert extract(resp)["input_tokens"] == 20
+
+    def test_input_tokens_without_tool_use(self):
+        resp = types.GenerateContentResponse(
+            usage_metadata=types.GenerateContentResponseUsageMetadata(
+                prompt_token_count=20,
+                candidates_token_count=10,
+                total_token_count=30,
+            )
+        )
+        usage = extract_gemini_usage_from_response(resp)
+        assert usage["input_tokens"] == 20
